summary: The phone says it may be behind while a host catches up, and no longer says it is all caught up before it has read whether it is

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites; no client contract change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: The phone reads the optional sync notice on the attention page the server already serves (one small page read a minute while connected); an older server without it reads as level. No client contract change.

downtime.detail: Normal phone app update; no additional startup work.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
